Assert that a Parquet file is structurally sound.

Source: R/parquet_integrity.R
assert_parquet_integrity.Rd

Build-time gate over a Parquet artifact. Aborts when check_parquet_integrity() reports any anomaly, so a corrupt multi-gigabyte cube fails loudly at the moment it is written instead of being read back truncated for months (whep#531).

Usage

assert_parquet_integrity(path, deep = FALSE)

Arguments

path

Path to a Parquet file.

deep

Whether to also read every row group and report the ones that fail to decode. Exact, but reads the entire file.

Value

Invisibly, path. Called for its side effect of aborting on violation.

Examples

path <- tempfile(fileext = ".parquet")
nanoparquet::write_parquet(data.frame(x = 1:10), path)
assert_parquet_integrity(path)
unlink(path)
